back: Computer systems that carry out tasks which normally need human intelligence, such as recognising speech and images or translating.
Speech recognition, image recognition (agriculture, medicine), recommendation, robotics, translation, chatbots.
Systematic unfairness in results, often caused by training data that does not represent everyone.
A high average can hide poor accuracy for a small group; test each group separately.
Some jobs are lost, some change and some are created; skills and training matter.
Many AI systems use personal data; it must be collected with permission, kept secure and used for the stated purpose.
Training large models uses a lot of energy and creates e-waste, but AI can help to reduce waste and detect problems early.
Give benefits and concerns, say who is affected, and reach a conclusion that follows from the points; a person stays responsible.
